lines.trans: Why wouldn't I meet such a talented young woman?
Since our brief encounter last year, I haven't heard news of you in ages — how have you been?
Of course I remember last year; I was in a bad mood back then and stirred up plenty of trouble.
Alright, say no more.
Didn't you want to compete on Twelve Singers?
Hello? It's me — I have a wild-card singer who needs to join our Episode One taping.
A wild card? Every mentor does get one wild-card spot, except you already waived yours earlier.
Besides, the production crew has already locked in the entire taping rundown.
I don't care — go work it out with them.
There are no unwritten underworld rules in this industry, so stop worrying over every step.

words.gram: Meaning: hesitate and overthink every step.
